name: n17-c27j-load
prompt: A twin-engine military turboprop transport aircraft at full take-off power on the ground: a deep, even propeller drone with a steady low beat from two large six-bladed propellers and a strong turbine roar, powerful but steady and unchanging, continuous. Outdoors, some distance away. Not loud, not alarming. Length: 8 seconds

comb.what: propeller comb at flight power (the six-bladed propellers' blade passes)
comb.source: the agent's measurement, 26 Nov 2026, on DVIDS recordings (assets/phobos-sounds/recordings/c27j.json): 101.9 to 102.3 Hz on six cabin cuts in flight from three aircraft, about 1,020 rpm for six blades (our inference, not a published figure). Only the first line falls under the comb check's 180 Hz, so it is a weaker check than the Osprey's

art_plan.why: S154, the C-27J Spartan under take-off power (loop). The recordings have only a take-off pass, whose pitch slides by Doppler, so the steady loop is generated and judged against the measured comb. Candidates only
